basis: Parent scene record +0x10 points to the array at image +0x74.
Its complete sixteen-byte record ends at independently referenced next object +0x84.
The existing initializer writes that next-object address into its global scene table.
The predicate is the exact registered zero-return entry; the action is a complete zero-return entry.
interpretation: The action and predicate read no arguments. Pointer values and scalars are produced symbolically by C.
